simplefun.toys.snow_angel.ready: Now jump for a snow angel!
jei.simplefun.party_popper: Paper, string and a dye make two. Use: confetti in the dye's color (at most 40 particles), used up, 3 s cooldown.
jei.simplefun.dice: Use: the server rolls 1-6, sneaking two dice. The result floats above your head and goes to chat within 16 blocks.
jei.simplefun.lucky_coin: Use: heads or tails, rolled by the server, shown above your head and in chat within 16 blocks.
jei.simplefun.skipping_stone: Throw flat over water: up to 5 skips with splash and count. No damage; record in the statistics.
jei.simplefun.water_balloon: Throw: douses fire, candles and campfires within one block, fills a cauldron by one level, wets players. Never hits mobs; steam in the Nether.
jei.simplefun.bubble_wand: Hold use: soap bubbles rise up to 8 blocks and pop at a ceiling. At most 12 per player; 64 uses.
jei.simplefun.paper_plane: Throw: glides, lands as an item. A book in the other hand folds its first page in; sneak + use reads it.
jei.simplefun.rubber_duck: Place on water or ground; click: squeak and hop. On soul sand it becomes the pirate duck.
simplefun.guide.page.1.title: Simple Fun
simplefun.guide.page.1: Bounded playful mechanics, throwable bricks and cosmetic transformations. The animal heads moved to Simple Mobheads.
simplefun.guide.page.2.title: Sneak Throw
simplefun.guide.page.2: Sneak while dropping items. Server multiplier 0.1–3, velocity capped at 1.5 blocks/tick, pickup delay 20 ticks.
simplefun.guide.page.3.title: Throwable Bricks
simplefun.guide.page.3: Brick, nether brick and resin brick: throw with use. Server cooldown 10 ticks, lifetime 200 ticks, damage 0–4. Glass breaking defaults off.
simplefun.guide.page.4.title: Piggy Transformation
simplefun.guide.page.4: Eating raw or cooked pork grants a cosmetic pig head for five minutes; milk removes the effect.
simplefun.guide.page.5.title: Damageless
simplefun.guide.page.5: Feather melee and Damageless I deal zero direct melee damage, with knockback. Novice librarians offer the book for 25 emeralds, three uses. Switches control effect and trades.
simplefun.guide.page.6.title: Knockback V
simplefun.guide.page.6: Vanilla Knockback accepts feathers/sticks and levels up to five; this replaces vanilla enchantment data and can collide with datapacks.
simplefun.guide.page.7.title: Admin Commands
simplefun.guide.page.7: Permission level 2: /simplefun tweaks yeet toggle/strength; /simplefun tweaks bricks enable/breakGlass/damage/snowballDamage. Values are bounded server-side.
simplefun.guide.page.8.title: Admin Commands
simplefun.guide.page.8: /simplefun config shows and changes every option of config/simplefun.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values). Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once.
simplefun.guide.page.9.title: Admin Commands
simplefun.guide.page.10.title: Brick Snowball
simplefun.guide.page.10: Four snowballs around one brick craft one. Stack 16. Separate switch; damage 0–4, throw cooldown 10 ticks.
simplefun.guide.page.11.title: Flower Sniff
simplefun.guide.page.11: Cosmetic delight: hold a flower and sneak. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.12.title: Cookie Crumbs
simplefun.guide.page.12: Cosmetic delight: eat a cookie. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.13.title: Apple Sparkle
simplefun.guide.page.13: Cosmetic delight: eat an apple. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.14.title: Carrot Crunch
simplefun.guide.page.14: Cosmetic delight: eat a carrot. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.15.title: Melon Splash
simplefun.guide.page.15: Cosmetic delight: eat melon. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.16.title: Honey Bubbles
simplefun.guide.page.16: Cosmetic delight: drink honey. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.17.title: Bread Crumbs
simplefun.guide.page.17: Cosmetic delight: eat bread. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.18.title: Berry Blush
simplefun.guide.page.18: Cosmetic delight: eat sweet or glow berries. Server switch; at most six particles and a quiet sound every five seconds. No gameplay rewards.
simplefun.guide.page.19.title: Party Popper
simplefun.guide.page.19: Paper, string and a dye craft two. Use: confetti in the dye's color rises (at most 40 particles) with a pop; used up, 3 s cooldown. No gameplay effect.
simplefun.guide.page.20.title: Dice and Coin
simplefun.guide.page.20: Dice (two bone meal + black dye) roll 1-6, sneaking two dice; the lucky coin (copper ingot + gold nugget) shows heads or tails.
simplefun.guide.page.21.title: Dice and Coin
simplefun.guide.page.21: The server rolls; the result floats above the head and goes to chat within 16 blocks; 1 s cooldown.
simplefun.guide.page.22.title: High Five
simplefun.guide.page.22: Sneak with an empty hand and click another player: you raise your hand for 3 s (they see a hint). Their click back claps: sound, sparks at both, the High fives statistic. No damage, no chat spam.
simplefun.guide.page.23.title: Petting
simplefun.guide.page.23: The owner sneaks with an empty hand and clicks an own tamed wolf, cat, parrot or horse: hearts and its contented sound, once every 10 s per animal; Pets given statistic. Wolves and cats do not toggle sitting on that click;
simplefun.guide.page.24.title: Petting
simplefun.guide.page.24: horses keep their Vanilla sneak click.
simplefun.guide.page.25.title: Skipping Stones
simplefun.guide.page.25: One cobblestone, tuff, andesite or cobbled deepslate makes four flat stones.
simplefun.guide.page.26.title: Skipping Stones
simplefun.guide.page.26: Thrown flat over water a stone skips up to five times with splash, ring and count; too steep or too slow it sinks. No damage, no block change; record in the statistics.
simplefun.guide.page.27.title: Water Balloon
simplefun.guide.page.27: Leather, string and a water bucket make four (the bucket stays). It hits only players and blocks:
simplefun.guide.page.28.title: Water Balloon
simplefun.guide.page.28: douses fire, lit candles and campfires within one block, fills a hit cauldron by one level and wets a hit player (fire out).
simplefun.guide.page.29.title: Water Balloon
simplefun.guide.page.29: No damage, nothing breaks; in the Nether it turns to steam. 5 s cooldown.
simplefun.guide.page.30.title: Bubble Wand
simplefun.guide.page.30: Stick, string and a water bucket (the bucket stays). Hold use: a soap bubble every 0.7 s rises up to 8 blocks and pops at a ceiling.
simplefun.guide.page.31.title: Bubble Wand
simplefun.guide.page.31: At most 12 bubbles per player; 64 uses. Pure particles: they block and carry nothing.
simplefun.guide.page.32.title: Paper Plane
simplefun.guide.page.32: One paper folds a plane. Thrown it glides, flies through creatures without harm and lands as an item (floating on water); best range at about 20 degrees up, at most 60 s.
simplefun.guide.page.33.title: Paper Plane
simplefun.guide.page.33: A book and quill or written book in the other hand folds its first page in (up to 200 characters); sneak + use reads the note.
simplefun.guide.page.34.title: Rubber Duck
simplefun.guide.page.34: Yellow dye, a slimeball and a gold nugget. Placed on a water surface (like a lily pad) or on solid ground; a click squeaks and makes it hop, touching does nothing. Placed on soul sand it becomes the pirate duck.
simplefun.guide.page.35.title: Snow Angel
simplefun.guide.page.35: Sneak still for 3 s on a snow layer, snow block or powder snow, then jump:
simplefun.guide.page.36.title: Snow Angel
simplefun.guide.page.36: a snow angel print of particles stays for 30 s (larger in a snowstorm) with a soft crunch. One angel per player; no block changes; Snow angels statistic.
simplefun.guide.page.37.title: Server Configuration
simplefun.guide.page.37: Two tabs cover gameplay and small delights; every option explains its default. Gameplay uses only server settings.
simplefun.guide.page.38.title: Creative tabs
simplefun.guide.page.38: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
simplefun.guide.page.39.title: Settings
simplefun.guide.page.39: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
